source: Empire State Development, Film Tax Credit quarterly reports (PDF), esd.ny.gov/esd-media-center/reports/film-tax-credit-<year>-quarterly-reports
period_rule: period = the calendar quarter the report covers (initial applications submitted in those three months), YYYYQn

units.projects: film production credit initial applications deemed eligible to submit a final application during the quarter
units.ny_budget_usd: Chart A Totals, Total NY Budget: estimated New York State spending of those projects, US dollars
units.hires: Chart A Totals, Number of Employees: estimated head count (not full-time equivalents) across those projects

note: Values read from each PDF's sentence 'During the <nth> quarter of <year>, the Film Tax Credit Program deemed N initial applications eligible to submit a final application for credits' and the Totals row of Chart A (Initial Applications Submitted During the quarter). Post-production credit applications are reported separately in the same PDFs and are not counted. The Q2 2026 report (quarter ended June 30, 2026) was not yet posted on September 21, 2026. Chart A totals are ESD's own sums.
